Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIXT.1.1 (Always unencrypted, must be first field in message)

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be second field in message)

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be third field in message)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Integer message sequence number. Sequence numbers are initialized at the start of each FIX session starting at 1 (one) and increment throughout the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request. Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: SenderCompID as assigned by Nasdaq Nordic (MPID in INET, FIX Session ID in NDTS). Outbound from Nasdaq: From 56 on the original inbound message.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Trader ID (User ID). This tag is not required on session level messages but is required for application level messages. Outbound from Nasdaq: INET: Indicator to denote which host system was involved (S = Order message, T = Trade Reporting message). NDTS: N/A

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: UTC. Outbound from Nasdaq: Please note that this time is the time the message left the FIX application. It has no relevancy to execution time, reject time, or cancel time in the destination systems.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: As per the information provided by Nasdaq Nordic. Outbound from Nasdaq: From 49 on the original inbound message.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: INET: Required 1-character that identifies this entry as an order entry or trade reporting message (S = Order message, T = Trade Reporting message). NDTS: Optional indicator to denote client software version. Outbound from Nasdaq: Receiving party's Trader ID (User ID), if this message is a query/response message. From 50 on the original inbound message. Not specified for On-Behalf-Of message responses. This tag is not required on session level messages.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Ignored. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Service Bureaus use this field to submit their customer's MPID. This value will be returned to you in tag 128 on the outbound message. Please note that while it is possible for you submit a chain of transactions with inconsistent values for this tag in different messages, you are strongly advised not to do so. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: When applicable, this tag holds the User ID (Trader ID) for the on behalf of firm. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resent as a result of a ResendRequest. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime. UTC

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop and service bureau on behalf of messages, this field contains the service bureau's customer's MPID.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop and service bureau on behalf of messages, this field contains the value entered in tag 116 on the inbound message.

Field.Name: DeliverToLocationID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop messages, this field (if provided) specify the account / port ID used when originally sending the message. Use together with OrigClOrdID [41] and DeliverToCompID [128] to chain an order modification to the original order.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, coded message that includes an indicator and text to explain reason for rejection: Invalid tag number; Required tag missing; Tag not defined for this message type; Undefined Tag; Tag specified without a value; Value is incorrect (out of range) for tag; Incorrect data format for value; Signature problem; Tag CompID problem; SendingTime accuracy problem; Invalid value for MsgType tag; Repeating group fields out of order; Incorrect number in group count for repeating group

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. It is the TestReqID received from the Test Request message.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Not supported. Must be 0.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat Interval in seconds - should be greater than 10 and less than or equal to 60.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: The default version of FIX messages used in this session.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Date/Time combination

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Beginning sequence number of Requested Message

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Ending sequence number of Requested Message

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Next expected sequence number

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Must be 14 characters or less. ClOrdID must be unique per connector per day. GTC Carryover orders retain their ClOrdID. Therefore, keep in mind when entering orders that you will not be able to enter an order with the same ClOrdID as a pre-existing GTC Carryover order.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Conditionally required if you are sending ISIN (SecurityID [48]) instead of OrderBookID (Symbol [55]).

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: This is required by FIX.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Identifies class of alternative SecurityID. Must be provided when SecurityID [48] is specified.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: This value represents the total Order Quantity.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price field is required for Limit Orders.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN code

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: OrderBookID or [N/A].

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Orders with OrdType [40] = 1 (Market) must have TIF = 3.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: The time that you released this request.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Routing Strategy. See section Order routing for more details. If tag 76 is not sent, the default is BOOK.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: MinQty is currently supported for orders with a TimeInForce [59] = 3, 4 and B or for hidden orders with TimeIn Force [59] = 0, 1, or 6. Minimum Quantity orders may be entered during the auctions; however, the minimum quantity feature will only be enforced during the continuous market and in the Auction On Demand (AOD) book. MinQty must be a round lot. For PureStream minimum available quantity on contra IOI to initiate a stream.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Displayed quantity, if the desire is to display only a portion of the order and not the full order quantity.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Required for GTT (GoodTillTime) orders, this is the time the order should be canceled at (current day). Format is UTC. The date portion must specify the current date.

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Integer representing the number of tick increments. User has two options on entry - If you enter "+" followed by the Peg difference, the result will be that the peg difference is a positive peg difference. If you enter "-" followed by the Peg difference, the result will be that the peg difference is a negative peg difference. If you do not provide the "+" or "-" sign, the system will enter your peg difference as a positive peg difference. For example: Entering "211=+1" will result in a peg difference of one positive tick increment.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: User supplied Clearing Firm. Pass-through field. (Note that the field is not forwarded to the CCP). Maximum 4 char.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Supplemental accounting information that is forwarded to the CCP. Field will only be used by the CCP if there is a bilateral agreement in place. Maximum 12 char.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: (See [529] for additional designations.)

Field.Name: OrderRestrictions
Field.Description: The following designations may be used in conjunction with [528] if applicable.

Field.Name: ClearingAccountType
Field.Description: Designates the account type to be used for the order when submitted to clearing.

Field.Name: SubMktID
Field.Description: Submarket ID/Market Segment. Numeric code for the desired submarket or Market Segment. Conditionally required if you are sending ISIN (SecurityID [48]) instead of OrderBookID (Symbol [55]).

Field.Name: ClRefID
Field.Description: User-supplied client reference to be returned unchanged in the private order/trade messages. Maximum 15 characters.

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Only applicable for reserve orders (MaxFloor [111] specified). Values > 1. Amount used to determine the random reserve range. If 200 is specified in this field, and the MaxFloor is set to 1000, the displayed amount will randomly shift between 800 and 1200.

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: May be used to specify different display options. The default for this tag is dependent upon the value sent in [111]. If 111=0, then the default for 9140 = N. Otherwise, the default is Y.

Field.Name: CrossTradeFlag
Field.Description: This specifies the cross in which the order goes live.

Field.Name: BrSeqNbr
Field.Description: User-supplied order reference to be returned unchanged in the private order/trade messages. Maximum 10 characters.

Field.Name: EffectiveTime
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. The time at which the strategy should kick off. Format is UTC. The date portion will be ignored but should always contain the current date. Valid values: 9:00-17:30. Default = a.s.a.p.

Field.Name: Target%Volume
Field.Description: Conditionally required for the POV strategy (client must enter this field or Max % of Volume). Defines the level of market impact by maintaining a certain level of market participation. Valid values: 0.01-99.99. Default = Null

Field.Name: Maximum%Volume
Field.Description: Conditionally required for the POV strategy (client must enter this field or Target % of Volume). Complements Target % of Volume were market participation moves between the max and min values. Valid values: 0.01-99.99. Default = Null

Field.Name: Minimum%Volume
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Alternative to Target % of Volume were market participation moves between the max and min values. Valid values: 0.01-99.99. Default = Null

Field.Name: Aggression
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Allowed values limited to 1-3 for the PNPR strategy. Valid values: 1-5. Default: 1

Field.Name: MinChildOrderValue
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Attempts to reduce the number of trades by defining a minimum child order value.

Field.Name: SpreadLimit
Field.Description: Conditionally required for the PNPAIR strategy. Basis point spread over or under the cash neutral price (or better) at which to trade. Can be negative.

Field.Name: RefPriceBidLeg
Field.Description: Conditionally required for the PNPAIR strategy. Defines the base relationship between the leg symbols.

Field.Name: RefPriceAskLeg
Field.Description: Conditionally required for the PNPAIR strategy. Defines the base relationship between the leg symbols.

Field.Name: LagBidLeg
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Defines how much the buy leg can execute behind the sell leg. Expressed as quantity. Valid values: > 0

Field.Name: LagAskLeg
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Defines how much the sell leg can execute behind the buy leg. Expressed as quantity. Valid values: > 0

Field.Name: LeadBidLeg
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Defines how much the buy leg can execute ahead of the sell leg. Expressed as quantity. Valid values: > 0

Field.Name: LeadAskLeg
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Defines how much the sell leg can execute ahead of the buy leg. Expressed as quantity. Valid values: > 0

Field.Name: StopLossBidLeg
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. To protect against the market prices moving away when the leg lags. If current market prices are above this limit, take the loss and execute the remainder. Valid values: > 0

Field.Name: StopLossAskLeg
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. To protect against the market prices moving away when the leg lags. If current market prices is below this limit, take the loss and execute the remainder. Valid values: > 0

Field.Name: BasketID
Field.Description: Conditionally required for the PNPAIR (PNPR) and SETUP PAIR (SUPR) strategies. Unique per order pair by client and day. Identifies the pair of orders (the same value for both legs).

Field.Name: Ratio
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Conditionally required for the SUPR strategy. Ratio aspect of the deal involved. Valid values: > 0

Field.Name: IWouldPrice
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Defines a price at which the trader wants to deviate from the strategy and finish the trade. When the market reaches this price, the strategy will take out all available liquidity at this price or better.

Field.Name: IWouldType
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Required if IWouldPrice [20006] is specified.

Field.Name: IWouldQty
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Required if IWouldPrice [20006] is specified. Absolute quantity or percentage that limits the quantity to sweep. Valid values: 1 - 1 000 000

Field.Name: CleanUpType
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Cleanup leaves quantity style.

Field.Name: CleanUpQty
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Leaves quantity to activate cleanup. Valid values: > 0. Default = 0

Field.Name: BlockFilter
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Threshold quantity for filtering out trades. Used to cause the algorithm to filter out any trade that is larger than this threshold. POV strategies could potentially trade inefficiently in attempting to chase the volume in a spike. Valid values: > 0 - 1 000 000. Default = Null

Field.Name: OnOpenType
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. If not specified, the algo does not participate in the opening.

Field.Name: OnOpenQty
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Required if OnOpenType [20010] = 1 or 2. Defines the quantity (units or %) that should be executed in the opening. Valid values: 1 - 1 000 000

Field.Name: OnCloseType
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. If not specified, the algo does not participate in the close.

Field.Name: OnCloseQty
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Required if OnCloseType [20011] = 1 or 2. Defines the quantity (units or %) that should be executed in the closing. Valid values: 1 - 1 000 000

Field.Name: DynamicBenchmark
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Benchmark for dynamic behavior. Defines price sensitivity to an index. Based on the In Money and Out Money parameters, the strategy can accommodate the client's belief that prices will experience trending or mean-reverting behavior. The strategy will dynamically react to those situations by adjusting its trading rate.

Field.Name: DynamicPrice
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Strike price for dynamic benchmark calculations. Required if DynamicBenchmark [20014]= 2 - Price

Field.Name: InMoneyStyle
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Dynamic behavior in the money

Field.Name: OutMoneyStyle
Field.Description: Honored for execution algo orders only. Dynamic behavior out of the money

Field.Name: STPLevel
Field.Description: Defines that the order is eligible for self-trade prevention and the scope of prevention.

Field.Name: STPAction
Field.Description: The parameter is ignored if the STP Level is not specified.

Field.Name: STPTraderGroup
Field.Description: Defines the trader group. Client defined values. Conditionally required for STP Level = 3, otherwise ignored.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Used to track order origination. Will use configured default if not provided.

Field.Name: TradingAtClosingPrice
Field.Description: If not included, pre-defined configuration will be used.

Field.Name: OrderCondition
Field.Description: Condition that in some way change the behavior of the order.

Field.Name: TargetStrategy
Field.Description: The target strategy of the PureStream order.

Field.Name: MinRate
Field.Description: PureStream minimum rate in the 1-500% range. (Default = 1%) Only used for TargetStrategy Custom.

Field.Name: MaxRate
Field.Description: PureStream maximum rate in the 1-500% range >= MinRate. (Default = 500%) Only used for TargetStrategy Custom.

Field.Name: ConditionalType
Field.Description: PureStream Order Type.

Field.Name: FirmUpID
Field.Description: If this is sent it needs to be with a value received on a firm-up request. It also requires ConditionalType to be F (Firm-Up Order). Can only be sent on an Firm-Up Order Request.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of cancel request as assigned by the institution. Must be 14 characters or less.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Identifies class of alternative SecurityID. Must be provided when SecurityID [48] is specified.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of most recent order (from order acknowledgement). [37] is required if you are cancelling an order from one FIX connector and the order was not originally entered on that connector (cancel over any).

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) when canceling or replacing an order.

Field.Name: Side

Field.Description: Identifies Trade Report message transaction type. Corresponds to MMT Flag 3.4 - Transaction Type: Modification Indicator

Field.Name: AlgoIndicator
Field.Description: Returned on fills and partial fills (ExecType [150] = F), where the execution was the result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.9 - Transaction Type: Algorithmic Indicator

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Returned on ExecType [150] = F (Trade) messages. Corresponds to MMT Level 1 - Market Mechanism.

Field.Name: TradingSessionSubID
Field.Description: Returned on ExecType [150] = F (Trade) messages. Corresponds to MMT Level 2 - Trading Mode (Session).

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Returned on ExecType [150] = F (Trade) messages. Corresponds to MMT Level 2 - Trading Mode (Trade Reporting).

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Returned on ExecType [150] = F (Trade) messages. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.1 - Transaction Type: Transaction Category

Field.Name: OrderCategory
Field.Description: Returned on ExecType [150] = F (Trade) messages. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.2 - Transaction Type: Negotiation Indicator

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: This flag is used to indicate whether DEA activity (as defined under MiFID II) is involved in the order. Returned on ExecType [150] = 0 (New), F (Trade) messages. As per the order. Will only be provided if provided on the inbound order message or if the default is DEA.

Field.Name: TradingAtClosingPrice
Field.Description: Indicates if the order should participate in trading at closing price.

Field.Name: OriginalOrderReferenceNumber
Field.Description: Original Order Reference Number for a restated GoodTilCancel order. Note: Updated when order is replaced.

Field.Name: OriginalOrderEntryDate
Field.Description: YYYYMMDD - Original Order Entry Date for a restated GoodTilCancel order. Note: Updated when order is replaced.

Field.Name: OrderCondition
Field.Description: Condition that in some way change the behavior of the order.

Field.Name: TargetStrategy
Field.Description: The target strategy of the PureStream order.

Field.Name: MinRate
Field.Description: PureStream minimum rate in the 1-500% range. Only used for TargetStrategy Custom

Field.Name: MaxRate
Field.Description: PureStream maximum rate in the 1-500% range >= MinRate. Only used for TargetStrategy Custom

Field.Name: ConditionalType
Field.Description: PureStream Order Type.

Field.Name: FirmUpID
Field.Description: For Firm-Up Requests (ConditionalType = "R"), ID to be used when firming up the IOI. Otherwise as per the IOI.

Field.Name: CumRate
Field.Description: The current cumulative streaming LTR the order is achieving (includes all active streams for this IOI)

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: As per cancel or cancel/replace request

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: If the cancel reject is for an unknown order this field will contain the text "NONE". Otherwise, it will contain the OrderID of the last order in the chain of orders.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Will contain the most recent status of the order or 8 = Rejected.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: As per cancel or cancel/replace request

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, message to explain reason for rejection.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: The MPID of the intended recipient of this message.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Identifies the type of request that a Cancel Reject is in response to.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: MPID of the contra party on the execution. Required for fills (ExecType [150] = F (Trade)). Otherwise optional. For execution algos, returns the child contra.

Field.Name: OrderAttributeType
Field.Description: Required if NoOrderAttributes [2593] >0

Field.Name: OrderAttributeValue
Field.Description: Required if NoOrderAttributes [2593] >0

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: The short code representing the client or decision maker represented by this block. Unsigned numerical only. Data corresponding to this short code must have been previously supplied, or will be supplied by the end of the calendar day, per our Rules. For clients, the following values are reserved for applicable use.

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Must always be P (Short code identifier)

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Specifies the role of the party to the trade. At this time, only the following values are valid.

Field.Name: PartyRoleQualifier
Field.Description: Provides further qualification of the PartyRole value.
